Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2-te te nje pallati 5-katesh.

sallon ndenje se bashku me te gatimi , dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet sebashku me nje depo.

Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
Per me shume informacion apo vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni Atrium127900
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Allias. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a 5-story building. It is organized in a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchen, two bedrooms and a toilet together with a storage room. Every room invested with premium brands. Televisions and coffee tables are not included in the sale. The area where the apartment is located has all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. It has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us Atrium127900
